Ideal for new joining welcome kits, festive corporate gifts, and executive appreciation, this elegant gift set reflects professionalism, sustainability, and modern utility. Presented in a brown box packaging, the hamper combines innovative tech accessories with eco-friendly stationery, making it a perfect blend of style and functionality.

Crafted under the trusted Wangari brand, this gift set is designed to align with contemporary workplace needs while reinforcing your brand identity. Whether you are onboarding employees, rewarding teams, or gifting business partners, this premium employee onboarding kit delivers lasting value and brand recall.

What’s Inside

  • Wangari Cherry Bamboo Wireless Earbuds – Eco-conscious wireless earbuds with superior sound quality, designed for calls, meetings, and music.
  • Wangari Custom 3D Printed Desk Lamp – A uniquely designed lamp that adds sophistication and functional lighting to any office desk.
  • Wangari Custom Tabletop Calendar – A practical and customizable desktop calendar that keeps schedules organized year-round.
  • Eco-Friendly Diary – Made with sustainable materials, perfect for daily notes, planning, and professional journaling.
  • Wooden Finish Ball Pen with Stylus – A premium pen featuring a smooth writing experience and stylus tip for digital convenience.

Why Choose This Employee Onboarding Kit

The Proem Gift Set| Employee Onboarding Kit stands out due to its balance of innovation, sustainability, and premium appeal. Each item is carefully selected to enhance productivity while promoting values. The elegant brown box packaging ensures a refined unboxing experience, making it suitable for corporate events, HR onboarding programs, and premium brand promotions.
